title: Stripe to buy OpenRouter as fintech expands deeper into AI
summary: Stripe has announced its acquisition of OpenRouter, marking a significant step in the company's strategy to delve deeper into the artificial intelligence model market. This move underscores Stripe's commitment to expanding its offerings beyond traditional payment processing. By integrating AI capabilities, Stripe aims to enhance its services and stay competitive in the rapidly evolving fintech landscape.
